answer: Each key that answers posts one ivory token of its own payout as bond to the wharf, locked until close and burned if a duplicate is proved under it. The wharf ledger keeps the sponsorship thread between keys, so one proven duplicate burns the token of every key below that thread, not just the caught one: a farm of 10 keys strands 10 tokens at one another's stake, and its 11th key adds another to a thread already carrying 10. A key opens 2 new threads a season, and only after 10 seasons of standing, so splitting the farm buys no fresh thread. Refuse the lock and the key is dropped.
